correctness.rationale: The extremizer identification is a premise from Mohr–Rautenbach's Theorem 2 in the stated range. In the graph itself a transversal avoiding x exists, so every maximum independent set selects exactly one vertex per clique. The only cross-clique constraint is that x excludes each yᵢ. Thus two queries in one clique fail the two-positive trace; if x is queried positive, a connector cannot be positive and the sole nonconnector of a two-vertex block cannot be negative. Conversely those are all obstructions: for x absent or negative, the central block has at least two non-x choices, and all other blocks have at least two choices each; when x is positive, queried blocks have at least two safe vertices. This realizes every trace and gives the two disjoint polynomial products. A full transversal avoiding x gives a depth-a nonadaptive query tree, while any all-positive path must query distinct vertices contained in one maximizing concept and so has length at most a. For topology the subcomplex without x is A=D_(r₀−1)*D_(r₁)*⋯, and the x-star attaches a cone along K, the join of the nonconnector sets in eligible other blocks. A non-x central vertex cones off K inside A, so the attaching inclusion is null; the homotopy cofiber is A∨ΣK when K is nonempty. Joins of nonempty discrete sets with at least two points give sphere wedges with multiplicity the product of their cardinalities minus one in each factor. For t=n−2a in 1,…,a−1 this gives 2^(t−1) spheres in dimension a−1 and one sphere in dimension t−1; t=1 instead has K with no vertices and x isolated, exactly the pointed S⁰ case. When all blocks are eligible the two ranks add in dimension a−1, as stated. Maximal faces containing x take one safe query in every eligible block, whereas maximal faces not containing x take one query per block and already have a central vertex. This gives the exact facet-size and purity assertions, independently of the finite mod-2 checks.
residual_risks: The result is for maximum-cardinality independent sets and a≥3,n>2a. It does not extend the extrema classification to a different graph regime or establish equivariant topology.

value.rationale: For a canonical connected extremal concept family, all shattered supports are classified, not just the dimensions. The answer identifies the exact threshold for purity, with a tunable lower homology degree below it and a simultaneous constant VC/Littlestone dimension despite a topological change. Those features explain a structural effect of two-vertex blocks that the optimizer count alone does not describe. The known boundary is not needed for this value.
residual_risks: No additional claim about learning algorithms, general graphs, or representation of homology under symmetries is supported.
